snippet.title: Valhalla 1v1 PvP Match!
snippet.description:
Are you climbing the Valhalla PvP leaderboards yet?

Bring up to 3 of your Veras into battle for a tactical match!

Watch this intense Flindorr vs. Flindorr face-off in a fight for dominance.

Think you can do better? Play now at valhalla.game and prove it!
